_README: Ground truth for the eval. Each entry states what the scorer SHOULD find in
that document, decided by reading the text -- not by running the scorer and
recording its output. Writing the manifest from the scorer's own output would
make the eval a tautology that passes no matter how wrong the scorer is.
These documents are deliberately NOT in data/corpus/. Scoring a document
against a baseline that contains it leaks the answer: its own values pull the
median toward itself and it looks more normal than it is.
must_flag      attributes the scorer must report. A miss is a false negative.
min_severity   the weakest acceptable severity for that finding.
max_high       cap on HIGH findings. Exceeding it means false positives.
notes          why the term was planted, for when a result needs explaining.

aggressive_nda_01.description: Eight deliberately aggressive terms. The recall test.

term_months.notes: Perpetual confidentiality. Corpus range is 18-60 months.

carve_outs_present.notes: No standard exclusions; the definition explicitly sweeps in prior knowledge and independently developed information.

non_compete_months.notes: 24-month non-compete inside an NDA. No corpus document has one at all.

non_solicit_months.notes: 36 months against a corpus norm of 12.

indemnification_present.notes: Uncapped indemnity. No corpus document imposes one.

attorney_fees_shifting.notes: Prevailing-party fee shifting; absent from the corpus.

is_mutual.notes: Titled 'Mutual' but entirely one-way. Substance over label.

notice_period_days.notes: 3-day destruction deadline against a corpus median of 30. Direction inverts here.

clean_nda_02.description: Deliberately unremarkable control. Any HIGH finding is a false positive.

mixed_nda_03.description: Mostly standard with three planted deviations. Tests discrimination rather than blanket flagging.

non_solicit_months.notes: 18-month non-solicit; only 2 of 8 corpus documents have one, at 12 months.

term_months.notes: 48 months, above the corpus p75 of 36 but inside the 18-60 range. Should register as mild, not severe.

carve_out:independently_developed.notes: Exactly one exclusion removed. Must be caught individually, not as the aggregate 'no exclusions' finding.
